title: <i>Mothers in Council</i>
---

This quarterly was edited by CMY 1890-1901.

It ran until 1930.

It was aimed at the educated members of the Mothers’ Union, as distinct from The Mothers’ Union Journal, which was aimed at the working-class mothers.
